hp_filter.application: Each complete transformed series filtered separately on the canonical sample; trend and cycle are in transformed units; cycle = transformed - trend.

moments_definition: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1), relative to output; contemporaneous correlation with output; lag-one autocorrelation; corr(x_t, Y_(t-4)) and corr(x_t, Y_(t+4)). All use aligned HP cycles.

provenance.sources: FRED-hosted CSVs, Fernald quarterly TFP workbook and BLS labor-share workbook; individual input filenames and units appear under raw_series.
provenance.vintage_caveat: Local file modification dates, not verified official observation vintages.

representation_notes: Economic levels are derived by exponentiating transformed log levels; raw_series contains source values over their available dates. HP components cover only the canonical sample.
GDP-deflated expenditure flows retain annualized (SAAR) scaling; these are not separately published chained-dollar component series.
Hours per capita is a normalized hours index, not hours per person. Compensation and productivity are indices, not dollar wages or physical productivity levels.
The real rate is already a level rate: economic_level is null. Its HP components are quarterly decimal-rate deviations, not logs or percentage growth rates.
Utilization-adjusted TFP is normalized to 1 in the authoritative implementation, despite the pipeline CSV unit label saying 100. Corrected units accompany the unchanged pipeline_unit_label.

TB3MS is a monthly FRED source series, but the local input contains quarter-start observations. The pipeline performs no monthly-to-quarterly aggregation; the original download aggregation convention is not documented.
Source redistribution permissions have not been verified; artifact generation does not constitute clearance for public redistribution.

Subsample HP trends, cycles, moments and HP-TFP AR(1) estimates are re-computed within each defined window, as in the research pipeline. Array values are aligned positionally with each sample's dates. Linear-detrend TFP AR(1) estimates are provided only for the canonical full sample, matching the current research calculation.

log_C_pc.hp_component_unit: natural log of thousands of 2017 dollars per person
log_C_pc.label: Consumption
log_C_pc.transformation: ln[((PCND+PCESV)/(GDPDEF/100))/(CNP16OV/1000)]; nondurables plus services, not total PCE.
log_C_pc.transformed_unit: natural log of thousands of 2017 dollars per person

log_I_pc.hp_component_unit: natural log of thousands of 2017 dollars per person
log_I_pc.label: Investment
log_I_pc.transformed_unit: natural log of thousands of 2017 dollars per person

log_Y_pc.hp_component_unit: natural log of thousands of 2017 dollars per person
log_Y_pc.label: Output
log_Y_pc.pipeline_unit_label: log real GDP per capita (thousands of 2017 dollars per million persons)
log_Y_pc.transformation: ln[(GDP/(GDPDEF/100))/(CNP16OV/1000)]; GDP in billions of dollars, CNP16OV in thousands of persons.
log_Y_pc.transformed_unit: natural log of thousands of 2017 dollars per person

log_hours_pc.hp_component_unit: natural log of hours index per million persons
log_hours_pc.label: Hours
log_hours_pc.pipeline_unit_label: log nonfarm business hours index per capita
log_hours_pc.transformation: ln[HOANBS/(CNP16OV/1000)]; an index divided by population, not hours worked per person.
log_hours_pc.transformed_unit: natural log of hours index per million persons

log_productivity.label: Avg. Labor Productivity
log_productivity.pipeline_unit_label: log output per hour, nonfarm business (index, 2017=100)
log_productivity.transformation: ln(OPHNFB); nonfarm-business output per hour; not divided by population.

log_tfp.label: TFP (measured)
log_tfp.transformation: ln(dtfp_level); Fernald business-sector dtfp annualized quarterly log growth /400, cumulated and exponentiated, rebased to 1947Q1=100.

log_tfp_util.label: TFP (util-adjusted)
log_tfp_util.transformation: ln(dtfp_util_level); Fernald measured TFP level divided by reconstructed utilization level (dutil /400 cumulated and exponentiated).

log_wage.label: Wage
log_wage.pipeline_unit_label: log real compensation per hour, nonfarm business (index, 2017=100)
log_wage.transformation: ln(COMPRNFB); nonfarm-business real compensation per hour; not divided by population.

real_rate.label: Real Rate
real_rate.pipeline_unit_label: ex-post quarterly real rate: TB3MS/400 minus next-quarter log GDP-deflator inflation
real_rate.transformation: TB3MS/400 - [ln(GDPDEF at t+1) - ln(GDPDEF at t)]; ex-post real rate, annualized nominal percent converted to a quarterly decimal; requires next-quarter price.
